text:
Sleep now, my child,

sleep with a smile,

for the ring of stars

is rocking you.


You delighted in the light

and you were happy.

You had every good thing

when you had me.


Sleep now, my child,

sleep with a smile,

for loving Earth

is rocking you.


You gazed upon the burning

crimson rose.

You embraced the world:

you embraced me.


Sleep now, my child,

sleep with a smile,

for it is God in the darkness

who is rocking you.

translation.title: Sleep, My Child…
translation.editorial_note: The repeated rocking joins mother, Earth, stars, and God in the same circular lullaby.
